About Govix Linux

Govix Linux is an Arch-based distribution shaped around clean engineering and a calm, focused computing experience. Its name reflects a fusion of tradition and technology, bringing a sense of clarity to the fast-moving world of Linux.

Philosophy

The system follows Arch principles—simplicity, transparency, and user control—while presenting them through a smooth, minimal environment designed to stay out of your way and support deep, distraction-free work.

Key Features

  • Rolling Arch base, always up to date.
  • Calamares graphical installer for effortless setup.
  • Lightweight tools crafted for performance and system clarity.
  • Unified black-and-white design language for a consistent aesthetic.
  • Optimized defaults aimed at modern machines and developers.

Live Environment

The Govix live session lets you explore the system exactly as it is meant to feel.

  • Username: govix
  • Password: king
  • Full sudo access for testing
  • Auto-login enabled
  • Session resets on reboot unless installed

Installation

The installation process is simple and guided:

  • Boot into the live ISO.
  • Open the Calamares installer.
  • Choose your partitions, locale, and user details.
  • Finish the setup and reboot into your new system.
